version_semantics.increment: Every accepted new PUT intent increments assignment version, including an identical permission set. Never reset on clearing or ledger expiry.
version_semantics.membership: Increment target membership authorization version atomically so previous R3 authority snapshots fail closed.
version_semantics.concurrency: Serialize the assignment stream and fresh authority with local SQL locks; compare expected_version before commit. Revocation must win before a later verification. No network IO under SQL locks.

idempotency.precedence: Revalidate workload, live person/session/device/MFA, organization, management permission and target before ledger lookup. Exact unexpired replay returns original mutation result before checking current expected_version; no new assignment/audit/version or expiry extension.
idempotency.conflicts: Another target, actor or body with the same scoped key is identity_idempotency_key_reused. In-progress is retryable 409; current version mismatch or exhaustion is nonretryable 409.
idempotency.expired: After seven days, an old intent cannot be re-created: its expected version is stale and assignment version never resets. A new mutation requires an explicitly current version. A replay result is historical, never current authority; GET reads live state.

audit: Actor and target resolved by backend; tenant/account/membership, before/after permissions, original operation and server time. Replay never rewrites the original audit. No new published event or outbox consumer is introduced.

privacy.logs: No cookies, bearer tokens, assignment payloads, keys, person IDs or authority snapshots in logs/traces.
privacy.encryption: TLS; identity operational state follows its at-rest protection.
privacy.retention: Current assignment/version follows the membership authority lifecycle and cannot reset after revocation; idempotency minimal result seven days as existing identity sensitive idempotency. Independent immutable audit follows ADR-016/035. No purge implementation or production retention evidence.
privacy.caller_storage: Only minimal workflow state; no cache of authorization decisions. Cookie/workload credentials retain their existing no-storage rules.

field_inventory.scope: inherited common subtree; no free detail

assignment.base: Organization membership authority and explicit authenticated administration; ADR-009/016/035 apply.
assignment.access: Private gateway workload plus live selected organization/person authority, organization scope, approved device and recent MFA.
assignment.encryption: TLS and identity operational at-rest protection.
assignment.export_correction: Own-organization authorized access/export; corrections are new audited assignments, never rewrite historical decisions.
assignment.third_parties_regions: No new third party or region authorized; no production processing demonstrated.
assignment.purpose: Administer and read the current explicit exceptional-permission assignment.
assignment.retention: Current assignment and durable counter follow membership authority lifecycle; never reset on clearing. Immutable audit follows ADR-016/035.

idempotency.base: Organization membership authority and explicit authenticated administration; ADR-009/016/035 apply.
idempotency.access: Private gateway workload plus live selected organization/person authority, organization scope, approved device and recent MFA.
idempotency.encryption: TLS and identity operational at-rest protection.
idempotency.export_correction: Own-organization authorized access/export; corrections are new audited assignments, never rewrite historical decisions.
idempotency.third_parties_regions: No new third party or region authorized; no production processing demonstrated.
idempotency.purpose: Bind and replay one explicit replacement intent without repeating effects.
idempotency.retention: Seven days for minimal bound result, with no extension on replay; immutable audit is separate.

error.base: Organization membership authority and explicit authenticated administration; ADR-009/016/035 apply.
error.access: Private gateway workload plus live selected organization/person authority, organization scope, approved device and recent MFA.
error.encryption: TLS and identity operational at-rest protection.

error.purpose: Minimal uniform rejection, correlation and retry decision without protected detail.
error.retention: Response only; no values in caller logs or authority cache.
